family.title: Quartz Transmission
family.summary: A MAGPIE crystalline-behavior family exploring alignment, transparent cages, optical field representation, phase failure, and structural reorganization.

provenance.source_notes: The original Quartz Transmission source remains preserved in the package. Version 0.2.0 adds Behavior 001: Alignment, a 60-second audio-visual state sequence moving from scattered observation through structural lock, phase failure, interference reorganization, transmission, and recursive decay.
